topics.title: Logarifm — Asosiy tushunchalar va xossalari
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — KIRISH VA ASOSIY XOSSALAR

Logarifm — bu daraja ko'rsatkichini topish amali. a^x = b tenglamasida x ni topish:
log_a(b) = x  ←→  a^x = b

Shartlar: a > 0, a ≠ 1, b > 0

Misollar:
- log_2(8) = 3, chunki 2³ = 8
- log_3(81) = 4, chunki 3⁴ = 81
- log_5(1/25) = -2, chunki 5⁻² = 1/25

ASOSIY 10 TA XOSSA (a > 0, a ≠ 1, b > 0, b ≠ 1):

1. a^(log_a(x)) = x
   Logarifm va daraja bir-birini bekor qiladi.
   Misol: 2^(log_2(5)) = 5, 10^(lg(7)) = 7

2. log_a(a) = 1  va  log_a(1) = 0
   Misol: log_5(5) = 1, log_100(1) = 0

3. log_a(x·y) = log_a(x) + log_a(y),  x,y > 0
   Ko'paytmaning logarifmi = logarifmlar yig'indisi.
   Misol: log_2(4·8) = log_2(4) + log_2(8) = 2 + 3 = 5
   XATO: log_a(x+y) ≠ log_a(x) + log_a(y)

4. log_a(x/y) = log_a(x) - log_a(y),  x,y > 0
   Bo'linmaning logarifmi = logarifmlar ayirmasi.
   Misol: log_3(27/9) = log_3(27) - log_3(9) = 3 - 2 = 1
   XATO: log_a(x/y) ≠ log_a(x) / log_a(y)

5. log_a(x^p) = p · log_a(x),  x > 0
   Daraja ko'rsatkichi oldiga chiqadi.
   Misol: log_3(√3) = log_3(3^(1/2)) = 1/2

6. log_a(x) = log_b(x) / log_b(a)  — O'TISH FORMULASI
   Logarifm asosini ixtiyoriy songa o'zgartirish mumkin.
   Misol: log_2(8) = lg(8)/lg(2) = 3

7. log_a(b) · log_b(a) = 1
   Asosni almashtirish: ko'paytma doim 1 ga teng.
   Misol: log_2(3) · log_3(2) = 1
   Demak: log_b(a) = 1 / log_a(b)

8. log_a(b) = log_(a^p)(b^p),  p ≠ 0
   Asos va argumentni bir xil darajaga ko'tarish mumkin.
   Misol: log_2(3) = log_4(9) = log_8(27)

9. a^(log_b(c)) = c^(log_b(a))
   Misol: 2^(log_3(5)) = 5^(log_3(2))

10. a^(√(log_a(b))) = b^(√(log_b(a)))

LOGARIFMIK FUNKSIYANING ANIQLANISH SOHASI:
log_a(f(x)) uchun shart: f(x) > 0
log_(g(x))(f(x)) uchun 3 ta shart bir vaqtda:
  (1) f(x) > 0
  (2) g(x) > 0
  (3) g(x) ≠ 1

Misol: y = log_(x²)(4-x) aniqlanish sohasini topish.
  4-x > 0 → x < 4
  x² > 0  → x ≠ 0
  x² ≠ 1  → x ≠ ±1
Javob: (-∞;-1) ∪ (-1;0) ∪ (0;1) ∪ (1;4)

TEZ-TEZ UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ log(a+b) = log(a)+log(b)  →  ✓ log(a·b) = log(a)+log(b)
  ✗ log(a/b) = log(a)/log(b)  →  ✓ log(a/b) = log(a)-log(b)
  ✗ log_a(x) x=0 da aniqlanadi →  ✓ faqat x>0 da aniqlanadi

topics.title: Logarifm — Tenglamalar va Tengsizliklar
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — TENGLAMALAR, TENGSIZLIKLAR VA GRAFIK

LOGARIFMIK TENGLAMALAR:

Asosiy tur 1: log_a(f(x)) = log_a(g(x))  →  f(x) = g(x)
(f(x) > 0 va g(x) > 0 ekanini tekshirish shart!)

Asosiy tur 2: log_a(f(x)) = b  →  f(x) = a^b

Misol: log_2(x-3) = 3
  x - 3 = 2³ = 8  →  x = 11
  Tekshiruv: 11-3 = 8 > 0 ✓

Misol: lg(x-3) - lg(x+9) = lg(x-2)
  lg((x-3)/(x+9)) = lg(x-2)
  (x-3)/(x+9) = x-2
  x-3 = (x-2)(x+9) = x²+7x-18
  x²+6x-15 = 0

LOGARIFMIK TENGSIZLIKLAR:
log_a(f(x)) > log_a(g(x)) bo'lganda:
  - a > 1 bo'lsa:     f(x) > g(x)  (ishora O'ZGARMAYDI)
  - 0 < a < 1 bo'lsa: f(x) < g(x)  (ishora O'ZGARADI!)

LOGARIFMIK FUNKSIYA GRAFIGI y = log_a(x):
  - a > 1 bo'lsa: o'suvchi funksiya, I va IV chorak
  - 0 < a < 1 bo'lsa: kamayuvchi funksiya, II va III chorak
  - Har doim (1; 0) nuqtadan o'tadi
  - y = -log_5(x): grafigi x o'qi bo'yicha simmetrik → III va IV chorak

JUFT VA TOQ FUNKSIYALAR:
  Juft: f(-x) = f(x)  →  grafik y o'qi bo'yicha simmetrik
  Toq: f(-x) = -f(x) →  grafik koordinatalar boshi bo'yicha simmetrik

Misollar:
  y₁ = 3^x + 3^(-x)              → JUFT (chunki 3^(-x)+3^x = 3^x+3^(-x))
  y₃ = √(20-x+x²) + √(20+x+x²) → JUFT
  y₅ = x² + lg|x|                → JUFT
  y₂ = 3x⁵ + x³                  → TOQ

SONLARNI TAQQOSLASH (log_a(b) ning ishorasi):
  a > 1,    b > 1   → log_a(b) > 0
  a > 1,    0<b<1   → log_a(b) < 0
  0<a<1,   b > 1   → log_a(b) < 0
  0<a<1,   0<b<1   → log_a(b) > 0

TAQQOSLASH QOIDASI:
  a > 1 bo'lsa: m > n  ←→  log_a(m) > log_a(n)
  0<a<1 bo'lsa: m > n  ←→  log_a(m) < log_a(n)

topics.title: Logarifm — Hisoblash va Soddalashtirish
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — HISOBLASH VA SODDALASHTIRISH

ASOSIY HISOBLASH USULLARI:

1. DARAJAGA KELTIRISH:
   log_a(a^n) = n
   log_(a^n)(a) = 1/n
   Misol: log_2(32) = log_2(2⁵) = 5
   Misol: log_4(2) = log_(2²)(2) = 1/2

2. O'TISH FORMULASI:
   log_a(b) = log_c(b) / log_c(a) = 1 / log_b(a)
   Misol: log_6(45) = log_3(45)/log_3(6) = (2+a)/(1+b)
   [agar log_3(5)=a, log_3(2)=b bo'lsa]

3. ZANJIR FORMULASI:
   log_a(b) · log_b(c) = log_a(c)
   log_a(b) · log_b(c) · log_c(d) = log_a(d)
   Misol: log_3(4)·log_4(5)·log_5(9) = log_3(9) = 2

4. DARAJALI IFODALAR (muhim!):
   a^(log_a(b)) = b
   10^(lg(x)) = x
   e^(ln(x)) = x
   a^(lg b) = b^(lg a)  ← bu xossa juda ko'p ishlatiladi!

MURAKKAB IFODALARNI SODDALASHTIRISH:

O'rinbosar usuli (t qo'yish):
  5^x + 5^(-x) = 13  →  t = 5^x qo'yamiz
  t + 1/t = 13  →  t² - 13t + 1 = 0
  (5^x - 5^(-x))² = (5^x + 5^(-x))² - 4 = 169 - 4 = 165

Geometrik qator bilan:
  1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ...    = 1/(1-1/2) = 2    [|q|<1 bo'lsa: S = a₁/(1-q)]
  1 - 1/2 + 1/4 - ...    = 1/(1+1/2) = 2/3
  4(1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ...) = 4·2 = 8

Mashhur hisoblash misollar:
  log_3(12) - log_3(4) = log_3(3) = 1
  2·log_5(10) - log_5(4) = log_5(100/4) = log_5(25) = 2
  log_2(3)·log_3(4)·log_4(8) = log_2(8) = 3

AMALIY QIYMATLAR (yodlash foydali):
  lg(2) ≈ 0.301     ln(2) ≈ 0.693
  lg(3) ≈ 0.477     π ≈ 3.14159
  lg(5) = 1 - lg(2) ≈ 0.699
  lg(6) = lg(2) + lg(3) ≈ 0.778
  lg(7) ≈ 0.845

LOGARIFM VA ILDIZ:
  log_(√a)(b) = 2·log_a(b)
  log_a(√b) = (1/2)·log_a(b)
  log_(∛a)(b) = 3·log_a(b)

topics.title: Mexanika — Kinematika asoslari
topics.content:
KINEMATIKA — MEXANIK HARAKATNING ASOSLARI

Kinematika — jismlarning harakatini sabablarga e'tibor bermay o'rganuvchi bo'lim.

ASOS TUSHUNCHALAR:
- Moddiy nuqta — o'lchamlari berilgan masalada ahamiyatsiz bo'lgan jism
- Trayektoriya — jism harakatlanayotgan yo'l
- Ko'chish (s) — boshlang'ich va oxirgi nuqtalar orasidagi vektor
- Yo'l (l) — trayektoriya bo'ylab bosib o'tilgan masofa (har doim l ≥ |s|)

TEKIS HARAKAT:
  v = const, a = 0
  s = v·t
  Misol: Mashina 72 km/h tezlikda 2 soat harakatlandi. s = 72·2 = 144 km

TEKIS O'ZGARUVCHAN HARAKAT:
  a = const ≠ 0
  v = v₀ + a·t
  s = v₀·t + (a·t²)/2
  v² = v₀² + 2·a·s

Misol: Avtomobil 0 dan 20 m/s gacha 10 s da tezlashdi.
  a = (v - v₀)/t = (20 - 0)/10 = 2 m/s²
  s = 0·10 + (2·100)/2 = 100 m

ERKIN TUSHISH:
  g ≈ 9.8 m/s² ≈ 10 m/s² (DTM da)
  h = g·t²/2 (boshlang'ich tezliksiz)
  v = g·t
  t = √(2h/g)

Misol: Jism 45 m balandlikdan tushdi. t = √(2·45/10) = √9 = 3 s
  v = 10·3 = 30 m/s

TIK OTILGAN JISM (yuqoriga):
  v = v₀ - g·t
  h = v₀·t - g·t²/2
  Maksimal balandlik: H = v₀²/(2g), t_max = v₀/g

GORIZONTAL OTILGAN JISM:
  x = v₀·t (gorizontal)
  y = g·t²/2 (vertikal)
  v = √(v₀² + (g·t)²)

BIR XILLIGI YO'Q HARAKAT:
  O'rtacha tezlik: v_o'rt = S_umumiy / t_umumiy
  XATO: v_o'rt ≠ (v₁+v₂)/2 (faqat tekis o'zgaruvchan harakatda)

BIRLIKLAR:
  1 km/h = 1/3.6 m/s
  72 km/h = 20 m/s
  36 km/h = 10 m/s
  54 km/h = 15 m/s

topics.title: Mexanika — Dinamika asoslari
topics.content:
DINAMIKA — HARAKAT SABABLARI

Dinamika — jismlarning harakatini kuchlar ta'sirida o'rganuvchi bo'lim.

NYUTONNING I QONUNI (Inersiya qonuni):
  Agar jismga kuch ta'sir etmasa yoki kuchlar muvozanatlashgan bo'lsa,
  jism tinch turadi yoki tekis to'g'ri chiziqli harakatda bo'ladi.
  ΣF = 0 → a = 0 → v = const

NYUTONNING II QONUNI:
  F = m·a
  a = F/m
  Kuch birligi: 1 N = 1 kg·m/s²

Misol: 5 kg jismga 20 N kuch ta'sir etsa:
  a = F/m = 20/5 = 4 m/s²

NYUTONNING III QONUNI:
  Har bir ta'sirga teng va qarama-qarshi ta'sir bor.
  F₁₂ = -F₂₁
  Kuchlar turli jismlarga ta'sir etadi!

OG'IRLIK KUCHI:
  Fg = m·g (Yerga tortilish)
  g ≈ 10 m/s² (DTM da)

IShQALANISH KUCHI:
  F_ishq = μ·N
  N — normal reaktsiya kuchi (gorizontal sirtda N = m·g)
  μ — ishqalanish koeffitsiyenti (0 < μ < 1)

Misol: 10 kg jism gorizontal sirtda, μ = 0.3
  F_ishq = 0.3 · 10 · 10 = 30 N

ELASTIKLIK KUCHI (Guk qonuni):
  F = -k·x
  k — bikrlik koeffitsiyenti (N/m)
  x — cho'zilish yoki siqilish

Misol: k = 200 N/m, x = 0.05 m → F = 200·0.05 = 10 N

QIYA TEKISLIK:
  Parallel tashkil etuvchi: F_par = m·g·sin(α)
  Normal tashkil etuvchi: F_norm = m·g·cos(α)
  Ishqalanish bilan: a = g·(sin(α) - μ·cos(α))

IMPULS:
  p = m·v
  Impulsning saqlanish qonuni: m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ = m₁v₁' + m₂v₂'

ISH VA ENERGIYA:
  Ish: A = F·s·cos(α)
  Kinetik energiya: Ek = m·v²/2
  Potensial energiya: Ep = m·g·h
  Energiyaning saqlanish qonuni: Ek₁ + Ep₁ = Ek₂ + Ep₂

QUVVAT:
  P = A/t = F·v
  Birlik: 1 Vt = 1 J/s

topics.title: Kimyo — Atom tuzilishi va davriy qonun
topics.content:
ATOM TUZILISHI VA DAVRIY QONUN

ATOM TARKIBI:
  Proton (p) — musbat zaryadli, massa ≈ 1 a.b.m.
  Neytron (n) — zaryadlanmagan, massa ≈ 1 a.b.m.
  Elektron (e) — manfiy zaryadli, massa ≈ 0.00055 a.b.m.

  Atom raqami (Z) = protonlar soni = elektronlar soni (neytral atomda)
  Massa soni (A) = protonlar + neytronlar
  Neytronlar soni: N = A - Z

Misol: ²³Na (natriy)
  Z = 11 (11 proton, 11 elektron)
  A = 23 → N = 23 - 11 = 12 neytron

IZOTOPLAR — protonlar soni bir xil, neytronlar soni farqli:
  ¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴C — uglerodning izotoplari (6 proton, 6/7/8 neytron)

ELEKTRON KONFIGURATSIYASI:
  Kvant sonlari: n (bosh), l (orbital), ml (magnit), ms (spin)
  l qiymatlari: 0=s, 1=p, 2=d, 3=f
  Har bir orbitalda maks 2 ta elektron (Pauli printsipi)
  Sublevel sig'imi: s=2, p=6, d=10, f=14

ELEKTRONLAR JOYLASHISH TARTIBI:
  1s → 2s → 2p → 3s → 3p → 4s → 3d → 4p → 5s → 4d → 5p → 6s → 4f
  Klechkovskiy qoidasi: n + l yig'indisi kichik bo'lgan sublevel avval to'ladi

Misol: Fe (Z=26) konfiguratsiyasi:
  1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 4s² 3d⁶
  Fe²⁺: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁶ (4s dan elektron ketadi!)

DAVRIY JADVAL QONUNIYATLARI:
  Davrda chapdan o'ngga:
    - Atom radiusi kamayadi
    - Ionlanish energiyasi ortadi
    - Elektromanfiylik ortadi
    - Metall xossalar kamayadi
  Gruppada yuqoridan pastga:
    - Atom radiusi ortadi
    - Ionlanish energiyasi kamayadi
    - Metall xossalar ortadi

VALENTLIK VA OKSIDLANISH DARAJASI:
  Valentlik — atom hosil qiladigan bog'lar soni
  Oksidlanish darajasi — shartli zaryad (musbat yoki manfiy)
  O ning oksidlanish darajasi: -2 (OF₂ da -1 bundan mustasno)
  H ning oksidlanish darajasi: +1 (metallar gidridi NaH da -1)
  F ning oksidlanish darajasi: har doim -1

topics.title: Kimyo — Kimyoviy bog'lanish turlari
topics.content:
KIMYOVIY BOG'LANISH TURLARI

KIMYOVIY BOG'LANISH — atomlarni molekulada yoki kristallda ushlab turuvchi kuch.

KOVALENT BOG'LANISH:
  Atomlar elektron juftlarini umumiy qiladi.
  Qutbsiz kovalent: bir xil atomlar orasida (H₂, O₂, N₂, Cl₂)
  Qutbli kovalent: turli metallmaslar orasida (HCl, H₂O, NH₃)
  Elektromanfiylik farqi: 0 < ΔEN < 1.7

  σ-bog' — atomlar orasidagi o'q bo'ylab hosil bo'ladi (birinchi bog')
  π-bog' — o'qqa perpendikulyar hosil bo'ladi (ikkinchi va uchinchi bog'lar)

  Misol: N₂ da uchtalik bog': 1σ + 2π
  Misol: O₂ da ikkitalik bog': 1σ + 1π
  Misol: H-Cl da bir bog': 1σ

ION BOG'LANISH:
  Metall + metallmas orasida elektronlar to'liq o'tadi.
  Elektromanfiylik farqi: ΔEN > 1.7
  Misol: NaCl → Na⁺ + Cl⁻
  Misol: CaO → Ca²⁺ + O²⁻
  Xususiyatlari: yuqori suyuqlanish harorati, suvda eriydi, elektr o'tkazadi (eritmada)

METALL BOG'LANISH:
  Metall atomlari valent elektronlarini umumiy "elektron gazi" sifatida bo'lishadi.
  Metallarga xos: elektr o'tkazuvchanlik, issiqlik o'tkazuvchanlik, plastiklik, yaltiroqlik

VODOROD BOG'LANISH:
  H atomi yuqori elektromanfiy atom (F, O, N) bilan bog'langan bo'lsa,
  qo'shni molekuladagi F, O, N bilan zaif bog' hosil qiladi.
  Misol: H₂O molekulalari orasida — shuning uchun suv qaynash harorati yuqori
  Misol: HF, NH₃ da ham vodorod bog' mavjud

DONOR-AKSEPTOR BOG'LANISH:
  Bir atom tayyor elektron juftini beradi (donor),
  boshqa atom bo'sh orbital bilan qabul qiladi (akseptor).
  Misol: NH₄⁺ hosil bo'lishida: NH₃ + H⁺ → NH₄⁺
  N — donor (erkin juft bor), H⁺ — akseptor (bo'sh 1s orbital)

MOLEKULA SHAKLI (VSEPR nazariyasi):
  2 juft → chiziqli (CO₂, BeCl₂)
  3 juft → tekis uchburchak (BF₃)
  4 juft → tetraedr (CH₄)
  2 bog' + 1 erkin juft → burchakli (H₂O, burchak 104.5°)
  3 bog' + 1 erkin juft → piramida (NH₃, burchak 107°)

GIBRIDLANISH:
  sp — 2 orbital, 180° (BeCl₂)
  sp² — 3 orbital, 120° (BF₃, C₂H₄)
  sp³ — 4 orbital, 109.5° (CH₄, H₂O)

questions.question_text: (96-6-52) y = log_3(2-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: log_3(2-x) aniqlanishi uchun 2-x > 0, ya'ni x < 2. Javob: (-∞; 2)

questions.question_text: (97-1-63) y = log_x(3-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: Shartlar: 3-x > 0 → x < 3; asos x > 0 va x ≠ 1. Kesishma: (0;1) ∪ (1;3)

questions.question_text: (97-6-64) f(x) = log_x(6-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(97-8-52) y = log_(x-1)(x - 1/4) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(97-9-75) n ning qanday butun qiymatlarida y = lg(nx^2 - 5x + 1) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasi (-∞; 1/4] ∪ [1; ∞) bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: nx^2 - 5x + 1 > 0 ning aniqlanish sohasi berilgan to'plam bo'lishi uchun diskriminant D = 25 - 4n = 0 bo'lishi kerak, ya'ni n = 25/4 emas. n=4 da D=25-16=9, ildizlar x=1/4 va x=1. Javob: 4

questions.question_text: (99-2-36) f(x) = sqrt(8-x) / lg(x-1) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasiga nechta butun qiymat tegishli?
questions.explanation: Shartlar: 8-x ≥ 0 → x ≤ 8; lg(x-1) mavjud va ≠ 0 uchun x-1 > 0, x-1 ≠ 1 → x > 1, x ≠ 2. Butun sonlar: 3,4,5,6,7,8 — 6 ta.

questions.question_text: (99-3-26) y = 1/ln(1-x) + sqrt(x+2) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(99-5-39) f(x) = log_2(64^(-x) - 8^(1-x)) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(99-6-29) y = log_3(x(x-3)) - log_3(x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: Shartlar: x(x-3) > 0 va x > 0. x > 0 da x(x-3) > 0 bo'lishi uchun x > 3. Javob: (3; ∞)

questions.question_text: (98-5-15) Quyidagilardan qaysilari juft funksiya? y1=3^x+3^(-x), y2=3x^5+x^3, y3=sqrt(20-x+x^2)+sqrt(20+x+x^2), y4=log_3(4x+1), y5=x^2+lg|x|
questions.explanation: Juft funksiya: f(-x)=f(x). y1: 3^(-x)+3^x = y1 ✓. y3: sqrt(20+x+x^2)+sqrt(20-x+x^2) = y3 ✓. y5: (-x)^2+lg|-x| = x^2+lg|x| = y5 ✓. Javob: y1, y3, y5
log_3(18) = log_3(2·9) = log_3(2) + 2. t = log_3(2) qo'yib: (2t^2 - t(t+2))/(2t+t+2) = (t^2-2t)/(3t+2) = t(t-2)/(3t+2). t=log_3(2) qiymatida hisoblash: javob 1/2.

questions.question_text: (99-4-55) Ifodaning qiymatini toping: (log_8(15) - log_8(3) + 2log_8(15) + 2log_8(3)) / (log_8(15) + log_8(3))
questions.explanation: Surat: 3log_8(15) + log_8(3). Maxraj: log_8(15) + log_8(3) = log_8(45). Surat = log_8(15^3 · 3) = log_8(45^3/3^2·3) ... soddalashtirib: 3·log_8(45)/log_8(45) = 3. Javob: 3

questions.question_text: (97-5-37) Hisoblang: lg_8(log_2(10)) + log_9(log_3(5))
